test_ItemCounter: test the ItemCounter class by adding and removing items and verifying counts
create_ItemCounter: create an ItemCounter instance to track counts of arbitrary items in a dictionary
add_item_ItemCounter: add an item to the ItemCounter to increment its count in the items dictionary
remove_item_ItemCounter: remove an item from the ItemCounter to decrement its count or delete it when zero
review_ItemCounter_items: review the ItemCounter items dictionary to inspect current item counts
